title: Sidewalk and Transit Amenities Program (STAP) Privacy and Data Protection Policy / Legal Privacy Protections
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Bureau of Street Services (StreetsLA) be instructed, in cogedinatienzozith the Information Technology Agency (ITA), and other appropriate City departments, and the City Attorney be requested to develop and report back within 45 days with a proposed Sidewalk and Transit Amenities Program (STAP) Privacy and Data Protection Policy that consolidates and builds upon existing STAP contractual and legal privacy protections and establishes clear standards governing cameras, sensors, interactive technologies, and associated data practices. I FURTHER MOVE that the proposed policy establish standards addressing, at a minimum, personally identifiable information; facial recognition and biometric identification; cameras and optical sensing technologies; recording and retention of images; individual tracking and profiling; data collection, ownership, access, retention, sharing, disclosure, and security; the direct and indirect sharing of data with other government authorities; third-party technologies and services; advertising-related data practices; public notice and transparency; surveillance and law enforcement uses; and procedures for evaluating emerging technologies. I FURTHER MOVE that the proposed policy establishes conditions under which cameras, optical sensors, and similar technologies may be used to support interactive STAP functionality, provided such technologies are operated consistent with applicable legal and contractual requirements and the privacy protections established by the policy. I FURTHER MOVE that the Bureau of Street Services, with the assistance of the City Attorney, identify any existing STAP contractual provisions, settlement requirements, or other legal requirements applicable to such technologies and ensure that the proposed policy is consistent with those requirements. I FURTHER MOVE that the Bureau of Street Services report back with the proposed STAP Privacy and Data Protection Policy, including any recommendations necessary for implementation, for consideration and adoption by the Council.
